read.en: Bloom Energy rose 5.5% on Oct 26 to $203.92, trading between $192.15 and $210.86 on 1.4 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($215.2), 10-day ($226.3), 30-day ($260.2) and 100-day ($247.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($219.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and below zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($241.14), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月26日上涨 5.5%，收于 $203.92，盘中区间 $192.15–210.86，成交量为平均水平的 1.4 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$215.2）、10 日（$226.3）、30 日（$260.2）和 100 日均线（$247.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$219.7）下方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$241.14），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The close reclaimed $197.5 (Sep 1 low), now support again, while the $210.9 high stalled at the $210.7–213.1 resistance (Oct 22 and 20 lows). Resistance is $210.7–213.1, then $215.2 (5-day) and $219.7 (200-day). Support is $197.5, then $189–192.2 (Oct 23 and 26 lows) and $185.9 (Aug 24 low). A close above $213.1 would target $219.7; a close below $197.5 would reopen $186–189.

r.en: Oct 26 high $210.9; Oct 22 and Oct 20 lows ($210.7–213.1)
